problem_type: Risk classifier lane level depended on file order: a later lower-risk file overwrote a higher lane level
symptom: PR #833 changed src/workbench/generationCanvas/reactFlow/ (connection handle stacking) yet its CI and main's CI at 5f17a7d17 skipped Canvas Acceptance (Linux); the regression surfaced only on the next PR (#834).
direct_cause: classifyValidationPolicy assigned `policy.canvas = matchesAny(path, FULL_CANVAS_PATTERNS) ? 'full' : 'critical'` per file. The reactFlow files raised canvas to full, then later files (store/, styles/, tests/ux/canvas-*.walk.mjs) rewrote it to critical. Re-running the classifier on #833's diff returns canvas=critical (performance=true), so the canvas-acceptance job's `if: canvas == 'full'` was false.
class_root: The only multi-level lane (canvas: none < critical < full) was written by plain assignment instead of a monotone max, so the result depended on diff ordering rather than on the riskiest file.
affected_population: Every PR or main push whose diff mixes full-canvas paths with ordinary canvas paths sorted after them
internal_only_reason: Internal CI risk-tier classifier; no external spec governs lane ordering.
invariants: Each lane level is the maximum over all changed files; file order never lowers a lane.

door_reduction.why_not: CI (select-quality-gate-profile) and local gates (run-gates-tests) are the two consumers of the one classifier; raiseCanvas is now the only writer of the canvas level inside it (three former direct assignments collapsed into it).

generality_proof: All three writes of policy.canvas go through raiseCanvas, which only raises; the other lanes are booleans or 'full'-only strings already set monotonically. The node test runs the #833 shape in both orders and the full-walk/ordinary pair in both orders.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Monotone max for the canvas lane level.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both former `policy.canvas = 'full'` writes now call raiseCanvas.
Only ever set to 'full' or true inside the loop; never lowered.

recurrence.reason: Any mixed diff with an ordinary canvas file sorted after a reactFlow file skips full canvas acceptance.
same_class_scan: rg "policy\.canvas\s*=" scripts: 3 writes before, 1 (inside raiseCanvas) after
Re-classified #833 diff (46b71c973..5f17a7d17): critical before, full after

prevention.invariant: Lane levels only rise across files.
prevention.failure_mode: validation-policy.node-test.mjs 'lane levels only rise' goes red on any order-dependent downgrade (positive control: old classifier -> 1 failure).
prevention.strategy: Route every canvas-level write through one monotone helper.

legacy_paths.rationale: The three direct assignments are replaced in the same change.

migration: None; classification is computed per run.
residual_risks: Other PRs merged while the bug existed may have skipped canvas acceptance; the next main push that touches reactFlow/ will re-run it.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 分档只在这一个分类器里算；节点测试两种顺序都跑，阳性对照：旧分类器 1 条红。
